sources.title: Optimizing wearable IMU configurations for running gait ... - Frontiers
sources.snippet: This study successfully demonstrated that a machine learning approach can determine a minimal-optimal IMU configuration for running gait analysis, effectively bridging the gap between convenience and accuracy.

sources.title: Preparing IMU data for wearable machine learning
sources.snippet: Wearable sensors produce continuous motion signals, while subjective annotations like pain or fatigue come as discrete self-reports. Preparing these different data streams for learning requires precision and consistency.
